dashboard.label: Gear and Sports
dashboard.description: Recorded gear usage can be incomplete. Names are preserved; correct aliases through overrides. No combined pace is calculated across sports. Year grain uses snapshot history; Comparable YTD ends at the import calendar date. Empty charts mean no eligible data in the selection. Automatic selects the first available metric; invalid bookmarked IDs show an explicit unavailable state. Availability is snapshot-wide and refreshes every five minutes.
